description: Every education data domain not shipped with real data in this release, with the reason and what would unblock it. Mirrors Package001_Geography's acquisition_backlog.json convention: no domain ships guessed or placeholder rows just to appear complete.
environment_blocker_affecting_all_items: This session's organizational egress policy blocked direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.edu.in/Wikipedia domains in both RC1 (2026-07-21) and RC2 (2026-07-22) — re-confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial via a live test fetch on both occasions, not a one-off failure. All datasets were collected via WebSearch snippets only as a result. A future session with WebFetch access to these domains would allow re-verification at higher confidence and would very likely unblock more of the domains below.
rc2_progress_note: RC2 was an enrichment pass on the 4 already-shipped datasets, not an expansion into new domains. Two entries below (rankings_nirf_naac_nba_detail, hostels_student_services) received partial progress as a side effect of enriching the universities dataset — see status PARTIALLY_ADDRESSED and the note field on each — but neither is complete as a standalone domain.

blocked_or_queued_domains.reason: State-wide government school directories run into the tens of thousands of individual schools; per-school verification at the field depth requested (fees, hostel, lab, NAAC-equivalent, lat/long) is not feasible via search-snippet research alone.
blocked_or_queued_domains.unblock_requires: Bulk structured data export (e.g. UDISE+ dataset access) rather than per-institution web research.

blocked_or_queued_domains.reason: Same scale problem as government schools; no authoritative bulk private-school directory was accessible this session.
